examples.en: Noah was a second banana on the programme.
examples.zh: 諾亞在節目中只是一名配角。

examples.en: I do not want to be a second banana for the rest of my career.
examples.zh: 我不想在餘下的職業生涯中一直擔任配角。

meaning.en: A person who has a supporting or less important role beside someone who receives more attention, authority or recognition.
meaning.zh: 在另一位較受重視、較有權力或較受注目的人身邊，擔任配角、輔助角色或處於次要地位的人。

register.summaryEn: Second banana is informal and mainly American. Dictionaries label it informal, slang or chiefly American, although it is widely understandable through films, television, sport and entertainment writing.
register.summaryZh: 它是偏美式的非正式用語，在電影、電視、體育及娛樂文章中頗常見。 雖然不少英語使用者都能理解，但在英式英語中，second fiddle 有時會較常見。
contextsEn: admiring, when the supporting person is highly effective
contextsZh: 欣賞一位出色的輔助人物。
register.formalZh: 這種句式應小心使用，因為所有格有時會令人覺得配角完全依附於主要人物。

fixedVariable.fixedEn: Keep the fixed words and word order shown in the source expression.
fixedVariable.fixedZh: 保留原檔目標表達中的固定字詞及字序。
fixedVariable.variableEn: Change only the verb form, possessive, tense or surrounding grammar permitted by the source patterns.
fixedVariable.variableZh: 只按照原檔句式改變動詞形式、所有格、時態或前後文法。

forms.example: Noah was a second banana on the programme.
Alex was the second banana in the comedy duo.

forms.form: Subject + be + second banana + to + person.
forms.example: Grace was second banana to the famous actor.

forms.form: Subject + play(s) / played / has played + second banana.
forms.example: Priya played second banana in the school show.

forms.form: Subject + serve / work / act + as + a / the second banana.
forms.example: Helen will serve as the second banana on the new talk show.

forms.form: Subject + become / remain / end up as + a / the second banana.
forms.example: Jay may become the second banana if the experienced presenter joins.

forms.form: Subject + be + cast / treated / seen / regarded + as + a / the second banana.
forms.example: The director cast Emma as the second banana.

forms.form: Subject + like / dislike / hate / mind / accept / refuse + being / playing second banana.
forms.example: Daniel did not mind being the second banana.

forms.form: As a / the second banana, + complete clause.
forms.example: As the second banana, Ava prepared the situations for the lead comedian’s jokes.
The second banana often receives less attention than the star.
Leo accepted the role of second banana.

forms.form: Subject + need / choose / find / hire + a second banana.
forms.example: The show needs a second banana who can react quickly.
Would you be willing to serve as the second banana for six months?
Sophie was the captain’s second banana.

specificForms.titleZh: 當你把某人歸類為一位配角或次要人物時，可以使用 a
specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + be + a second banana.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + be + a second banana。

examples.en: Noah was a second banana on the programme.
examples.zh: 諾亞在節目中只是一名配角。

examples.en: I do not want to be a second banana for the rest of my career.
examples.zh: 我不想在餘下的職業生涯中一直擔任配角。

examples.en: She may be a second banana now, but she has the ability to lead.
examples.zh: 她現在可能是配角，但她有能力帶領團隊。

specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Subject + be + the second banana.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Subject + be + the second banana。

examples.en: Alex was the second banana in the comedy duo.
examples.zh: 亞歷克斯是這個喜劇組合中的配角。

examples.en: Who is the second banana on the new talk show?
examples.zh: 誰是新清談節目的第二號人物？

examples.en: Ruby became the second banana after the new host arrived.
examples.zh: 新主持加入後，露比成為了配角。

specificForms.formula: Subject + be + second banana + to + person.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Grace was a second banana in several films.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 當 second banana 透過 to 直接與另一個人比較時，通常不使用冠詞。 格雷絲在幾部電影中擔任配角。

examples.en: Grace was second banana to the famous actor.
examples.zh: 格雷絲在那位著名演員身邊擔任配角。

examples.en: Sam has always been second banana to the team captain.
examples.zh: 山姆一直在隊長身邊處於次要位置。

examples.en: Helen may become second banana to the new presenter.
examples.zh: 海倫可能會成為新主持身邊的配角。

specificForms.formula: Subject + play(s) / played / has played + second banana.
specificForms.descriptionEn: examples include play second banana, play second banana to someone and play second banana on a team.
specificForms.descriptionZh: Play second banana 是最常見的句式之一。 它可以描述真正的表演者，也可以描述工作、體育或其他合作關係中的次要角色。

examples.en: Priya played second banana in the school show.
examples.zh: 普里雅在學校表演中擔任配角。

examples.en: Priya played second banana to the lead singer.
examples.zh: 普里雅在主唱身邊擔任配角。

examples.en: He is tired of playing second banana.
examples.zh: 他已厭倦一直擔任配角。

specificForms.titleZh: 這些動詞說明某人正在擔任輔助角色
specificForms.formula: Subject + serve / work / act + as + a / the second banana.
specificForms.descriptionEn: After as, a or the is normally used when second banana refers to a role occupied by one person.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些動詞說明某人正在擔任輔助角色。 當 second banana 表示某人所擔任的角色時，as 後面通常使用 a 或 the。

examples.en: Helen will serve as the second banana on the new talk show.
examples.zh: 海倫將在新清談節目中擔任第二號人物。

examples.en: He worked as a second banana during the early part of his career.
examples.zh: 他在職業生涯初期曾擔任配角。

examples.en: The assistant presenter acted as the second banana whenever the main host was present.
examples.zh: 每當主要主持在場時，助理主持都會擔任配角。

specificForms.titleZh: 這些句式分別表示某人進入、繼續留在，或最後意外落入次要位置
specificForms.formula: Subject + become / remain / end up as + a / the second banana.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Nina remained second banana to the main presenter.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些句式分別表示某人進入、繼續留在，或最後意外落入次要位置。 妮娜仍然在主要主持身邊擔任配角。

examples.en: Jay may become the second banana if the experienced presenter joins.
examples.zh: 如果那位經驗豐富的主持加入，傑伊可能會成為配角。

examples.en: Nina remained the second banana despite her strong performance.
examples.zh: 儘管妮娜表現出色，她仍然只是第二號人物。

examples.en: Oscar ended up as the second banana in his own project.
examples.zh: 奧斯卡最後竟然在自己的項目中成為配角。

specificForms.titleZh: 這些句式表示另一個人或團體把某人放在次要位置
specificForms.formula: Subject + be + cast / treated / seen / regarded + as + a / the second banana.
specificForms.descriptionEn: He did not want to be regarded as a second banana.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些句式表示另一個人或團體把某人放在次要位置。 他不希望被視為配角。

examples.en: The director cast Emma as the second banana.
examples.zh: 導演安排艾瑪擔任配角。

examples.en: His colleagues treated him as a second banana.
examples.zh: 他的同事把他當作次要人物。

examples.en: The public saw her as the second banana in the partnership.
examples.zh: 公眾把她視為這段合作關係中的第二號人物。

specificForms.titleEn: After verbs expressing feelings or choices
specificForms.formula: Subject + like / dislike / hate / mind / accept / refuse + being / playing second banana.
specificForms.descriptionEn: Felix refused to play second banana to his new partner.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 當 being 或 playing 接在另一個動詞後面時，應使用 -ing 形式。 費利克斯拒絕在新拍檔身邊擔任配角。

examples.en: Daniel did not mind being the second banana.
examples.zh: 丹尼爾不介意擔任配角。

examples.en: Tara hated playing second banana to her manager.
examples.zh: 塔拉討厭在經理身邊擔任次要角色。

examples.en: Nathan accepted being a second banana because he preferred less pressure.
examples.zh: 內森接受擔任配角，因為他較喜歡壓力較小的角色。

specificForms.titleEn: At the beginning of a sentence
specificForms.formula: As a / the second banana, + complete clause.
specificForms.descriptionEn: As the second banana, Ava supported the main performer.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些句式把目標表達放在句子前半部分，避免每個答案都使用相同位置。 在開首的 As 短語後，應使用逗號。

examples.en: As the second banana, Ava prepared the situations for the lead comedian’s jokes.
examples.zh: 艾娃身為配角，負責為主要喜劇演員的笑話鋪排情境。

examples.en: Being the second banana gave Sophie more time for her family.
examples.zh: 擔任配角令蘇菲有更多時間陪伴家人。

examples.en: As a second banana, he was valuable even though he was not the star.
examples.zh: 作為配角，雖然他不是主角，但仍十分有價值。

specificForms.titleEn: As the subject of a sentence
specificForms.titleZh: 配角通常比主角得到較少關注
specificForms.descriptionEn: The role of second banana suited Ryan.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 配角通常比主角得到較少關注。 配角的位置很適合賴恩。

examples.en: The second banana often receives less attention than the star.
examples.zh: 配角通常比主角得到較少關注。

examples.en: A good second banana can make the leading performer more effective.
examples.zh: 一位出色的配角可以令主要表演者表現得更好。

examples.en: Being the second banana does not mean that your work is unimportant.
examples.zh: 擔任配角並不代表你的工作不重要。

specificForms.descriptionEn: Rosa’s second banana role included checking the timing and introducing the guests.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些句式把 second banana 當作某種角色或地位的名稱。 羅莎的配角工作包括檢查時間和介紹嘉賓。

examples.en: Leo accepted the role of second banana.
examples.zh: 里奧接受了配角的位置。

examples.en: The second banana position gave her less pressure.
examples.zh: 第二號人物的位置令她承受較少壓力。

examples.en: Noah’s second banana status did not stop him from influencing the team.
examples.zh: 諾亞雖然處於次要地位，仍能影響團隊。

specificForms.titleZh: 這些句式表示挑選一個人擔任配角
specificForms.formula: Subject + need / choose / find / hire + a second banana.
specificForms.descriptionEn: They hired Chloe as the second banana on the morning programme.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 這些句式表示挑選一個人擔任配角。 他們聘請克洛伊擔任早晨節目的第二號人物。

examples.en: The show needs a second banana who can react quickly.
examples.zh: 節目需要一位反應敏捷的配角。

examples.en: The team chose Aaron as the second banana to the captain.
examples.zh: 團隊選擇亞倫擔任隊長身邊的第二號人物。

examples.en: The director found a reliable second banana for the lead actor.
examples.zh: 導演為男主角找到了一位可靠的配角。

specificForms.descriptionEn: Source grammar frame: Who is the second banana?.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 原檔列出的句法框架：Who is the second banana?。

examples.en: Would you be willing to serve as the second banana for six months?
examples.zh: 你願意在六個月內擔任配角嗎？

examples.en: Yes, I would be willing to serve as the second banana for six months.
examples.zh: 是的，我願意在六個月內擔任配角。

specificForms.titleZh: 所有格可以指出那位較重要的人物或所屬團體
specificForms.descriptionEn: Use this structure carefully. A possessive expression may make the person sound as though they belong to or depend completely on the leading person.
specificForms.descriptionZh: 所有格可以指出那位較重要的人物或所屬團體。 這種句式應小心使用，因為所有格有時會令人覺得配角完全依附於主要人物。

examples.en: Sophie was the captain’s second banana.
examples.zh: 蘇菲是隊長身邊的第二號人物。

examples.en: The presenter introduced his second banana.
examples.zh: 主持介紹了自己的配角。

examples.en: As the team’s second banana, Chloe handled the details.
examples.zh: 克洛伊身為團隊中的第二號人物，負責處理細節。

benefits.titleEn: It describes an unequal partnership compactly
benefits.titleZh: 簡潔描述地位不相等的合作關係
benefits.en: The idiom combines the ideas of support, lower importance and reduced attention.
benefits.zh: 亞歷克斯是本身邊的配角。 這個慣用語把「輔助」、「地位較低」和「受到較少關注」幾個意思集中在一起。

examples.en: Alex was the second banana to Ben.
examples.zh: 亞歷克斯是本身邊的配角。

benefits.titleZh: 可以表達對次要地位的不滿
benefits.en: The sentence communicates more than a job description. It shows that the speaker feels overshadowed.
benefits.zh: 我已厭倦在生意夥伴身邊擔任次要角色。 這句話不只是描述工作角色，還表示說話者覺得自己被對方掩蓋。

examples.en: I am tired of playing second banana to my business partner.
examples.zh: 我已厭倦在生意夥伴身邊擔任次要角色。

benefits.titleEn: It can express acceptance or modesty
benefits.en: The expression can show that the speaker accepts a supporting role without shame.
benefits.zh: 我不介意擔任配角。 我較喜歡協助處理細節。 這個表達可以表示說話者並不介意擔任輔助角色。

examples.en: I do not mind being the second banana. I prefer helping with the details.
examples.zh: 我不介意擔任配角。我較喜歡協助處理細節。

benefits.titleEn: It highlights the value of supporting performers
benefits.en: The main person may receive more attention, but the supporting person may still be essential.
benefits.zh: 一位出色的配角可以令主角的表現更精彩。 主要人物可能得到較多關注，但配角仍可能十分重要。

examples.en: A skilled second banana can make the star’s performance much stronger.
examples.zh: 一位出色的配角可以令主角的表現更精彩。

benefits.titleEn: It is useful when discussing films, teams and partnerships
benefits.titleZh: 適合討論電影、團隊及合作關係
benefits.en: The expression helps speakers describe who leads and who supports without giving a long explanation.
benefits.zh: 這個表達可以讓說話者簡潔說明誰負責帶領、誰擔任輔助角色。

benefits.titleEn: It is an alternative, not an automatic improvement
benefits.titleZh: 它是一個替代說法，並非在所有情況下都更好
benefits.en: Use second banana when the unequal level of attention or importance matters. Use deputy, assistant or supporting member when a neutral or formal description is needed.
benefits.zh: 當句子需要突出關注或重要程度不平等時，才適合使用 second banana。 需要中性或正式描述時，可以使用 deputy、assistant 或 supporting member。

origin.statusEn: General Development Well Documented; Exact Reason for “Banana” Uncertain 整體演變有較充分記錄;使用 banana 的確切原因不明

history.en: The expression gradually moved beyond comedy. It came to describe any person who works beside a more important or more noticeable figure in a secondary capacity.
history.zh: 後來，這個表達逐漸不限於喜劇表演，而是用來形容任何在較重要或較受注目人物身邊擔任次要角色的人。

origin.memoryEn: The top banana is the star; the second banana stands beside the star in the supporting position.
origin.memoryZh: Top banana 是主角；second banana 則站在主角身邊擔任配角。

rules.titleEn: Do not change the core words
rules.titleZh: 規則一：不可改變核心字詞
rules.en: Do not change the core words

rules.titleZh: 規則二：不可按字面翻譯
rules.zh: 第二隻香蕉配角第二號人物次要人物陪襯角色

rules.titleEn: Choose the article according to the grammar shell
rules.titleZh: 規則三：按照句法框架選擇冠詞
rules.en: Do not memorise one article and place it before the expression in every sentence.
rules.zh: 不要只記住一個冠詞，然後在每個句子中都使用相同形式。

rules.titleZh: 規則四：play 後一般不使用冠詞
rules.zh: play 後一般不使用冠詞

rules.titleEn: Use “to” to identify the leading person
rules.titleZh: 規則五：使用 to 指出主要人物
rules.en: With may suggest partnership, but it does not clearly show who occupies the more important position.
rules.zh: With 可能只表示合作，並沒有清楚指出誰的地位較重要。

rules.en: Do not change may become into became.
rules.zh: 不要把 may become 改成 became，否則會把可能性變成已發生的事實。

rules.titleEn: Preserve whether the role is accepted or disliked
rules.titleZh: 規則七：保留當事人接受或不滿這個角色的態度
rules.en: The incorrect answer reverses Tara’s attitude.
rules.zh: 錯誤答案把塔拉的不滿改成樂意接受。

rules.titleEn: Do not use it merely for “second place”
rules.titleZh: 規則八：不可只因某人排名第二而使用
rules.en: The race result does not create a supporting relationship between Ben and the winner.
rules.zh: 比賽名次並沒有建立本與冠軍之間的配角關係。 本在體育節目中擔任第二號人物，因為主要主持得到差不多所有關注。

examples.en: Ben was the second banana in the sports programme because the main presenter received nearly all the attention.
examples.zh: 本在體育節目中擔任第二號人物，因為主要主持得到差不多所有關注。

rules.titleEn: Do not assume every assistant is a second banana
rules.titleZh: 規則九：不要把每個助手都視為配角
rules.en: An assistant may have an equal, independent or highly important role. Use second banana only when the context establishes that one person is clearly less prominent or less important than another.
rules.zh: 助手可能擁有平等、獨立或十分重要的角色。 只有當語境清楚表示某人較不受注目或地位較次要時，才應使用 second banana。

rules.titleZh: 規則十：清楚建立人物角色的意思
rules.en: This does not show that either person was more important. This clearly licenses second banana.
rules.zh: 亞歷克斯站在本身邊，並不代表其中一人較重要。 本是喜劇表演的主角，而亞歷克斯擔任配角。 這個語境清楚支持使用 second banana。

rules.titleEn: Do not repeat the idiom’s meaning unnecessarily
rules.titleZh: 規則十一：不要不必要地重複慣用語的意思
rules.en: The second half merely explains the idiom again. Preparing the situations is a specific task, not merely a repetition of “supporting role”.
rules.zh: 句子後半部分只是在再次解釋慣用語。 亞歷克斯是這個喜劇組合中的配角。 亞歷克斯身為配角，負責為本的笑話鋪排情境。 鋪排情境是一項具體工作，並不只是重複「擔任配角」。

examples.en: Alex was the second banana in the comedy duo.
examples.zh: 亞歷克斯是這個喜劇組合中的配角。

examples.en: As the second banana, Alex prepared the situations for Ben’s jokes.
examples.zh: 亞歷克斯身為配角，負責為本的笑話鋪排情境。

rules.titleEn: Use it carefully about real people
rules.titleZh: 規則十二：形容真實人物時應小心使用
rules.en: Only makes the statement more dismissive.
rules.zh: 我很樂意擔任配角，因為我較喜歡在鏡頭以外工作。 你在這裏只不過是個配角。 會令這句話帶有更強烈的貶低語氣。

examples.en: I am happy to be the second banana because I prefer working away from the cameras.
examples.zh: 我很樂意擔任配角，因為我較喜歡在鏡頭以外工作。

examples.en: You are only the second banana here.
examples.zh: 你在這裏只不過是個配角。

rules.titleZh: 規則十三：不要只使用娛樂語境
rules.en: The expression began in show business, but modern examples also appear in sport, work, politics and other partnerships.
rules.zh: 這個表達源自演藝界，但現代用法亦可見於體育、工作及其他合作關係。

instructions.en: Rewrite or respond to each item using second banana.
instructions.zh: 使用 second banana 改寫句子或完成回應。

questions.prompt: Ben was the star of the comedy duo. Alex had the supporting role and received less attention.
questions.promptZh: 本是這個喜劇組合的主角。亞歷克斯擔任配角，得到的關注較少。
questions.answer: In the comedy duo, Alex was the second banana to Ben.
questions.answerZh: 在這個喜劇組合中，亞歷克斯是本身邊的配角。
questions.targetMeaning: A person who has a supporting or less important role beside someone who receives more attention, authority or recognition.

questions.prompt: The lead singer was the centre of attention in the school show. Priya performed beside her in the less important role.
questions.promptZh: 主唱是學校表演的焦點。普里雅在她身邊擔任較次要的角色。
questions.answer: Priya played second banana to the lead singer in the school show.
questions.answerZh: 普里雅在學校表演中擔任主唱身邊的配角。
questions.targetMeaning: A person who has a supporting or less important role beside someone who receives more attention, authority or recognition.

questions.prompt: Noah helped the main presenter on the news programme, but the audience saw the presenter as the important figure.
questions.promptZh: 諾亞在新聞節目中協助主要主持，但觀眾把主要主持視為重要人物。
questions.answer: On the news programme, Noah was a second banana to the main presenter.
questions.answerZh: 在新聞節目中，諾亞是主要主持身邊的次要人物。
questions.targetMeaning: A person who has a supporting or less important role beside someone who receives more attention, authority or recognition.

questions.prompt: The head coach made the important decisions. The assistant coach worked beside him in the supporting position.
questions.promptZh: 總教練作出重要決定。助理教練在他身邊擔任輔助角色。

questions.prompt: Felix appeared to occupy the less important position in the group. However, the other members depended on him to keep everything organised.
questions.promptZh: 費利克斯看來在團體中處於較次要的位置。不過，其他成員都依靠他維持一切井然有序。
questions.answer: Although Felix appeared to be a second banana, the other group members depended on him to keep everything organised.
questions.answerZh: 雖然費利克斯看來只是一個配角，但其他組員都依靠他維持一切井然有序。
questions.targetMeaning: A person who has a supporting or less important role beside someone who receives more attention, authority or recognition.
